title: .ai/kanon.yml
description: The project overlay that standards-discovery writes. Read as the JSON value of the file. A missing file, or a file with no mode key, means canon-first. Rules the schema cannot say are checked by check-overlay.py: change needs rule, adopt and off take no rule.

mode.description: canon-first applies the Kanon as written. project-first treats the project's own conventions as the standard. standards-discovery writes only project-first.

overlay.description: One entry per Kanon rule the project adopts, changes or switches off. A bare overlay: key is null to YAML readers, so the list has at least one item.

effect.description: adopt: the project already follows the rule. change: the project follows a different rule, written in the file named by rule. off: the project does not follow the rule.

rule.description: A prose rule file for a change entry, relative to the repo root.

evidence.description: Where the repo shows the convention: path:line or path:line-line, relative to the repo root. A path holds no colon and no backtick.

entry.description: One Kanon rule, named by its catalog ID.
